```lean
theorem lg_target {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (s : Set Ω) : μ s ≤ 1 := by
  have h1 : μ s ≤ μ Set.univ := MeasureTheory.measure_mono_set s Set.univ
  have h2 : μ Set.univ = 1 := MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure.univ_eq_one μ
  rw [h2] at h1
  exact h1
```
